en.t: It was a winter evening, and the sky hung low and gloomy.

units.source_text: 我在从横须贺发车的上行二等客车的角落里坐着出神，静静等着开车的笛声。

en.t: I sat absentmindedly in the corner of an upbound second-class carriage departing from Yokosuka, quietly waiting for the whistle to signal departure.

units.source_text: 车上的电灯亮了很久了，车厢里只有我一个乘客，很是难得。

en.t: The lights in the train had been on for quite some time, and unusually, I was the only passenger in the carriage.

units.source_text: 今天和往常差别很大，车窗外昏暗的站台上，除了一只被关在笼子里的小狗时不时嗷叫两声，一个人影也没有。

en.t: Today was very different from usual: on the dim platform outside the window, there was not a single human figure, only a little dog shut in a cage that barked now and then.

units.source_text: 寂寥的环境倒是和我的心境很是契合。

en.t: That lonely setting, if anything, suited my mood very well.

units.source_text: 我感觉身心俱疲，心情和即将下雪的低沉天空一样阴郁。

en.t: I felt exhausted in body and mind, and my mood was as gloomy as the low sky that seemed about to bring snow.

units.source_text: 我无精打采的呆坐在座位上，双手揣在大衣兜里，连把晚报掏出来的力气都没有。

en.t: I sat listlessly in my seat with both hands tucked into my overcoat pockets, without even the strength to take out the evening paper.
